2026-11-15 draft · both are UniFi 24-port keystone panels · fill = patch cord colour · dashed = run not pulled or gear not bought
A1–A16 patch straight down to Pro Max ports 1–16 (6" cords); A17–A24 free for future runs
Patch panel B (U28), rack gear and WAN
B1–B10 patch down to the UDM Pro; B11–B16 are rear-port gear and DAC pass-throughs to the Aggregation
F1–F8 patch sideways to Basement Flex ports 1–8 in the same 1U mount
PM = USW Pro Max 16 PoE: on the UPS; ports 13–16 are 2.5 GbE. Flex = Basement USW Flex 2.5G 8 PoE: every port 2.5 GbE PoE,
on its own adapter (on battery once the PDU Pro arrives); its uplink moves to SFP+ → Aggregation, freeing Pro Max port 12.
Agg = USW Aggregation (8× SFP+). Doorbell run in copper; cameras can use the CCA box. Rear-port rack gear enters panel B from the back.
Dark = run exists but stays unpatched until used.
